result:
I’d make it impossible for people to easily ignore the suffering their choices cause others.

Not by forcing kindness—just by making the consequences vivid and real to them. If everyone had to genuinely feel the ripple effects of apathy, exploitation, indifference, or cruelty, I think the world would reorganize itself pretty quickly. Not into a paradise, but into something more honest.
